title: Suzu Travels — Diwali in India: where to be (2026)
_status: spec only 2026-10-09 (scheduled run blocked at setup-motion.sh, 8th time) — needs photos, then lint/snapshot/render. Timely: post window ~18 Oct – 7 Nov 2026.
_music_note: Last two rendered: Our Story Begins (kerala), Vadodora (dmc); queued unesco-45 = Magistar, evisa-60 = Tabuk. Eastern Thought (last used 30 Sep) = warm, festive. Fallback: Naraina.

_sources.diwali_date: DoPT closed-holiday list 2026 (via staffnews.in, fetched 2026-10-09): 'Diwali (Deepavali) | November 08 | Kartika 17 | Sunday'.
_sources.dev_deepawali: 24 Nov 2026 = Kartik Purnima; DoPT list has Guru Nanak's Birthday (also Kartik Purnima) on Tuesday 24 Nov 2026; multiple festival calendars give Dev Deepawali Varanasi 24 Nov 2026. Re-check before posting.
_sources.tips: Lit-up bazaars, lake views, booking early, quiet Diwali day = Suzu tips, not statistics. No religious claims beyond 'festival of lights'.
